title: Midnight Neon Drive // Synthwave Chill Radio
description: Step into the driver's seat of an 80s sports car and drift through the neon-drenched grid of a futuristic city. Perfect background vibes for hacking, design, and dreaming.

title: Coding a Neural Network from Scratch in Assembly
description: Because writing in Python is too mainstream. Watch me lose my mind trying to optimize matrix multiplications in x86-64 assembly language over the span of 12 hours.

title: Exploring Tokyo's Hidden Cyberpunk Alleys at 3 AM
description: A quiet walk through the glowing neon streets, rain-slicked concrete, and hidden vending machines of Shinjuku. Cinematic 4K Binaural audio for ultimate immersion.

title: Building the Ultimate Mech Keyboard (ASMR / Sound Test)
description: Lubing linear switches, installing custom foam, and modding stabilizers on a custom aluminum 65% keyboard. Full sound profile test at the end.

title: Why I Switched from VS Code to Vim (And Regret It)
description: It has been three months. I still don't know how to exit. My terminal has become my prison. Send help. Here is my honest review of modal editing.

title: Ambient Space Journey to the Edge of the Universe
description: Relax and unwind with slow-motion visualizations of deep space nebulas, black holes, and distant galaxies accompanied by deep ambient drones.

title: Design Systems: The Secret to Speed or a Creative Prison?
description: An opinionated look at atomic design, component libraries, and how Figma files are taking over developer sanity. Let's talk about styling constraints.

title: Analog Synthesizers: A Deep Dive into Frequency Modulation
description: Patching patch bays, manipulating oscillators, and exploring the warmer side of sub-bass. A hands-on tutorial with Eurorack hardware modules.
